{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace BridgeContract

inductive Edge where
  | mk (u : Nat) (v : Nat)

deriving instance BEq for Edge

def edgeU (e : Edge) : Nat :=
  match e with
  | Edge.mk u v => u

def edgeV (e : Edge) : Nat :=
  match e with
  | Edge.mk u v => v

def validN (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  n ≤ 10

def validEdges (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ edges, edgeU e < n ∧ edgeV e < n

def isSelfLoop (e : Edge) : Bool :=
  edgeU e = edgeV e

def isBridge (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (i : Nat) : Bool :=
  let e := edges.get? i
  match e with
  | none => false
  | some e =>
    if isSelfLoop e then
      false
    else
      let edgesWithout := edges.filter (fun j => j ≠ i)
      let comps := connectedComponents n edges
      let compsWithout := connectedComponents n edgesWithout
      compsWithout > comps

def connectedComponents (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) : Nat :=
  let adj : List (List Nat) := List.rep n []
  let adj' : List (List Nat) :=
    List.foldl (fun acc e =>
      let u := edgeU e
      let v := edgeV e
      let accU := acc.get? u
      let accV := acc.get? v
      match accU, accV with
      | some lu, some lv =>
        let newU := lu ++ [v]
        let newV := lv ++ [u]
        let accU' := acc.set? u newU
        match accU' with
        | some acc1 =>
          let accV' := acc1.set? v newV
          match accV' with
          | some acc2 => acc2
          | none => acc1
        | none => acc
      | _ => acc
    ) adj edges
  let visited : List Bool := List.rep n false
  let visited' : List Bool :=
    List.foldl (fun acc i =>
      let vi := acc.get? i
      match vi with
      | some false =>
        let adjI := adj'.get? i
        match adjI with
        | some neighbors =>
          let newVisited := dfs n adj' i (acc.set? i true).getD acc
          newVisited
        | none => acc
      | _ => acc
    ) visited (List.range n)
  List.count visited' true

def dfs (n : Nat) (adj : List (List Nat)) (cur : Nat) (visited : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  let neighbors := adj.get? cur
  match neighbors with
  | none => visited
  | some neighbors =>
    let visited' : List Bool :=
      List.foldl (fun acc v =>
        let vv := acc.get? v
        match vv with
        | some false =>
          let newVisited := acc.set? v true
          match newVisited with
          | some nv => dfs n adj v nv
          | none => acc
        | _ => acc
      ) visited neighbors
    visited'

def solve (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) : List Nat :=
  let bridges : List Nat :=
    List.filter (fun i => isBridge n edges i) (List.range (edges.length))
  bridges

theorem thm (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge) (h1 : validN n) (h2 : validEdges n edges) :
  (∀ i ∈ solve n edges, isBridge n edges i = true) ∧
  (∀ i, i < edges.length → isBridge n edges i = true → i ∈ solve n edges) ∧
  (List.Sorted (· < ·) (solve n edges)) := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (n : Nat) (edges : List Edge), validN n ∧ validEdges n edges ∧
  (∃ i, i < edges.length ∧ isBridge n edges i = true) ∧
  (∃ i, i < edges.length ∧ isBridge n edges i = false) := by sorry

end BridgeContract",
